name: Eleven Realtime v1 Mini
access: ElevenAgents: Voice mode Realtime, conversation_config.realtime_model eleven_realtime_v1_mini (the default Realtime model); rolling out gradually, and a workspace without access gets an error [el-rt-models] [el-changelog-1019]

ElevenLabs Realtime API, compatible with OpenAI's Realtime API: wss://api.elevenlabs.io/v1/convai/realtime, with a short-lived client secret from POST /v1/convai/realtime/client_secrets; WebSocket only [el-rt-openai] [el-rt-secret] [el-blog-rt]
Data residency: US, EU, India and Singapore; not under Zero Retention Mode or HIPAA [el-rt-models]

voice.input_audio: Realtime API: audio/pcm (default, 24 kHz), audio/pcmu or audio/pcma, set in audio.input.format; over WebSocket the client captures and plays PCM16 at 24 kHz itself [el-rt-secret] [el-rt-openai]. In ElevenAgents the agent's own audio settings apply [el-rt-models]
voice.output_audio: Realtime API: audio/pcm (default), audio/pcmu or audio/pcma, set in audio.output.format [el-rt-secret]
voice.voices: any voice of the ElevenLabs library, which the launch post puts at 17,000+; the Realtime API default voice is brian [el-blog-rt] [el-rt-secret]
languages: 90+ languages, the Eleven v4 language list; on the Realtime API, audio.input.transcription.language sets the language of transcription, speech and reply (default en) [el-models-1031] [el-rt-secret]
voice.turn_detection: Realtime API: turn_detection type semantic_vad (default) or server_vad, eagerness low, medium (default) or high, with create_response, threshold, prefix_padding_ms, silence_duration_ms and turn_timeout (default -1) [el-rt-secret]. In ElevenAgents the agent's turn eagerness and timeout settings still apply [el-rt-models]
voice.interruption: Yes: interrupt_response defaults to true on the Realtime API; in ElevenAgents the agent's interruption settings still apply [el-rt-secret] [el-rt-models]
voice.session_limit: Realtime API: max_duration_seconds defaults to 600, and the server closes the session with code 1000 when it is exceeded [el-rt-secret]; the API reference gives no ceiling, and the changelog entry of 2026-10-19 gives a range of 60 to 7,200 seconds [el-changelog-1019]
voice.latency: Artificial Analysis: 0.62 seconds average time to first audio on its Big Bench Audio set [aa-s2s-1031]; the maker's pages give 620 ms [el-rt-page] [el-pricing-api-1031]

pricing_usd_per_mtok.notes: Token rates are the LLM usage of the model, on top of US$0.08 per minute of connected audio; burst audio above the concurrency limit is US$0.16 per minute; the same rates on every plan, with estimated included minutes from about 14 to about 11,794 by plan. In ElevenAgents the standard per-minute agent rate plus tokens at the model's rates [el-pricing-api-1031] [el-rt-models]. Artificial Analysis lists US$4.80 per hour of input audio [aa-s2s-1031]
